title: Consolidate the three failure-excerpt blocks into one helper, changing no behavior
action: Three modules carry the same failure-excerpt block, each with its own 500-char constant and its own truncation call. Extract one pub(crate) helper into crate::fsutil, beside write_text_atomic, and call it from all three. This cell changes NO behavior: same bound, same trimmed tail, same '(no output; exit N)' fallback, no log file, no new record key — that arrives in ffe-2. The three blocks and their constants, verbatim from rg: fsutil is the home because textutil is text-only by locked decision (js-parity-cleanup D3, textutil.rs:1-15) and performs zero IO, while fsutil already owns ensure_dir (:95), write_text_atomic (:156) and remove_file_if_exists (:178) and is already imported by all three call sites (test_runner.rs:49, cells/finish_support.rs:7, drivers/close.rs:7). Sites: packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/finish_support.rs:29 (FAILURE_EXCERPT_MAX_CHARS = 500) and its block at :115-128; packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/close.rs:33 (FAILURE_EXCERPT_MAX = 500) and its block at :140-153; packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/test_runner.rs:66 (FAILURE_EXCERPT_MAX = 500) and its block at :281-291. Fold, do not preserve, one difference: finish_support.rs:118 assigns its trim back into `output` while the other two bind a local `trimmed`; `output` is dead after that block (:129 pushes only command/exit/duration/excerpt), so keep the local form. The exit type differs — Option<f64> at finish_support.rs:37 against Option<i64> at close.rs:82 and test_runner.rs:218 — and both render identically (jsjson.rs:42 prints an integral f64 with no fraction; finish_support.rs:103 builds it from an integer code), so pick whichever helper signature avoids a lossy conversion at any call site and convert at the caller. PROOF OF THIS CELL: every existing test passes with no assertion changed. Exactly one mechanical edit is allowed and expected — test_runner.rs:537, :538 and :544 name FAILURE_EXCERPT_MAX directly, so those three references retarget the surviving pub(crate) constant while asserting the same values. If you find yourself changing any other test, stop: the consolidation was not behavior-preserving and the cell is wrong. Do not delete a constant that still has a live reference.
